Semiconductor rebound — SOXX +2.70% premarket after −3.79% Monday; no single Lattice company headline confirmed, a sector-bounce gap after a weak month (down ~29% over the prior 30 days).

shorts.thesis: Q3 beat on EPS ($0.49 vs $0.47) but revenue $3.74B roughly in line to slightly below estimates, GMV $119.1–$119.2B vs ~$120B+ expected, and gross operating profit $1.781B vs $1.799B expected; gapping below its 50-day moving average and a $151.29 cup-with-handle buy point.

Fiscal Q2 beat (EPS $0.54 vs $0.49, revenue $579.9M vs $568M) spoiled by guidance — current-quarter EPS guide $0.44–$0.45 vs ~$0.51 expected, full-year EPS guide cut to $1.88–$1.90 vs $1.96 expected, with the Arize acquisition cited.

Sell-the-news despite a beat — Q3 revenue $2.313B (+96%) vs ~$2.17B expected, EPS $0.44 vs $0.40, full-year guide raised to ~$8.53B — with attention on Q3 closed contract value of $2.9B, down from the prior quarter.
